reviews.text: The best cake that I got for my dog
I ordered 2 beautiful cakes. All 5 of my dogs absolutely loved the Pawlicious cakes! I will order again!
Amazing detail! My fur baby loved it: thank you

A fresh made-to-order cake on the same day.... wonderful! The packaging, communication, decoration was all fantastic. The cake was so fresh, I almost took a bite. Lol. I decided to go somewhere different this year. Let us say it was worth the 45 min trip. The place I normally go to gives a frozen cake I must thaw out for 4-6 hours, half the size, and not fresh out the oven.
I will definitely order in the future!
Thank you!!
A+++
The cake was awesome and my furbabies love it.  Much bigger than the chain stores for the same cost!
Pawlicious Cookies and Co did a great job on Sally's birthday cake! She loved it!

Pawlicious went above and beyond for this guy’s birthday!! We couldn’t have been happier and so was our dog (he ate it in record time haha). Customer service is top tier just like these amazing cakes!! Thank you again for creating such a special cake.

Absolutely OBSESSED! 🩷From the moment I picked up Baby London's birthday cake, I couldn't stop smiling. It was beyond anything I imagined absolutely gorgeous, luxurious, and every little detail was perfection.

London is only 3 pounds, and she loved every bite. It was such a special way to celebrate her birthday, and the cake was the star of the party. You can truly tell how much love, creativity, and talent goes into every cake they make.

The entire experience was amazing from start to finish. They were so friendly, easy to work with, and brought my vision to life flawlessly. If you want your fur baby's birthday to be extra special, this is the place to go! Thank you for making my little princess feel like the queen she is. We can't wait to order again! 🎂✨💕

Our experience was wonderful with Pawlicious Cookies & Co. Even with the holiday weekend, and as a last minute order they turned out a beautiful cake.  I love that you can select the cake flavor, because my boy can be picky, but he absolutely loved his pumpkin cake. From the presentation of the cake in the box, to the cake itself, everything was superb.
First doggie cake for my dood, Milo. Him and his brother loved it! Super easy to order and very friendly owners running this cute business. We will definitely be returning customers.
Brilliant cake worth every penny. Yolanda was able to make accommodations for pick up same day which was a total life saver. Will be returning every year!

Pawlicious Cookies exceeded all of our expectations! We ordered a peanut butter cake for our one-year-old dog, Lalo, and he absolutely loved every bite.
Lalo has a sensitive stomach and occasionally struggles with diarrhea, so I'm cautious about treats and special foods. I was impressed by the all-natural ingredients, and the cake was not only delicious for him but also gentle on his tummy. To be safe, we divided the cake over two days and monitored him closely for any adverse reactions. I'm happy to report that he had no issues at all and felt great afterward.
The presentation was beautiful, and you can tell that a lot of care and attention goes into every detail. It's wonderful to find a small business that creates such high-quality treats with ingredients pet parents can feel good about.

So impressed with Yolanda's work. The cake we got was perfect and our dogs DEVOURED it. She was able to have this cake ready within an hour and a half from when we called. She is so sweet and personable as well. I will definitely be back!
I bought cupcakes to see if my dog would eat it before I ordered a whole cake and he loved it. I will be back for the whole cake on his 1st birthday. Thank you.
This is my second time ordering a cake from Pawlicious and they have been so great! The dogs love them and they're beautiful!

Last Thursday was my Chihuahua’s 3rd birthday so decided to throw him a little party and found Pawlicious for the perfect cake he loved his cake so much he was excited when he saw it definitely will order again for his upcoming birthdays!!☺️
Thank you so much for the cake and cupcakes! My boys loved it for their 5th birthday! 🥳 Can’t wait to order again! …

Our girls share a birthday month and wanted to do something special for them. We decided to get them a cake and we’re so glad we did! The cake is much larger than expected and the quality is top tier. We decided on a round cake with the carrot and peanut butter flavor and pink icing (made from mashed potatoes!) The cake was also handed to me with birthday hats that made the occasion even more memorable! Everyone loved the cake and we will certainly be ordering from them again!
Thank you for your review!

I requested 4 pupcakes for a friend’s dog who just got a brain tumor diagnosis. They turned out perfect and the little dog treats with her name on them was even better! Thank you! This review isn’t allowing photos currently but they turned out perfect!
The cake was perfect! Will definitely be ordering again! They really made my big boys 1st birthday really special

I ordered a birthday cake for my dog Bella’s 4th birthday, and I couldn’t be happier with how it turned out! The cake was absolutely adorable so cute and beautifully made. You can tell a lot of care and detail went into it.
Most importantly, Bella loved it! The candle and her name is treats was a very special touch. She was so excited and clearly enjoyed every bite. It made her special day even more perfect. I would definitely recommend this to anyone looking to treat their pup to something extra special

Super duper HIGHLY recommend! Not saying always may be the case lol, but they got me in within 3 hours or less. Extremely satisfied with Yolanda and her team! My pup absolutely LOVED his cake! Especially for the Oak Cliff area. Don’t look further. Thanks Pawlicious 🙏 …
We love her cakes! They are so cute & according to my pups DELICIOUS
I purchased a cake for my Dog Ella who turned 1 year old. The cake was ready at the time I wanted and I even got a free muffin! Ella ate it all up!

The cake turned out amazing! I appreciated how flexible they were with pick up amidst the crazy snow storm. Communication and customer service were top notch! Highly recommend to anyone who wants to spoil their pup and support local business.
Can yall tell she loved her cake?! ☺️ it was beautiful and the customer service was so good! Thank you Yolanda and Pawlicious cookies for making my Rosie’s 1st birthday so special!
Amazing and beautiful cake! My dog loved it so much! They are extremely nice, helpful and accommodating with your questions and needs! Definitely recommend getting your dogs next cake from them!

loved the cake, my dog thought it was so tasty & the staff was extremely helpful & super sweet, thank you guys!!

edit: last pic is from her second birthday, love this place!! recommended it to so many people!!

Our sweet boy turned 6 and I placed an order on Thursday Thanksgiving day and they were able to have it ready for me by Saturday morning. I Absolutely loved how well packaged and beautifully everything was. Thank you so much!
Ordered same day and was able to pick up, very easy to order and they were very nice. My dog enjoyed her cake! Also a plus that you provide the little hat.

Pawlicious made a cake for my dog’s 10th birthday. The cake came out beautifully! Not only that, the owner was communicative throughout the process and even had the cake ready earlier than the scheduled time. My dog really enjoyed the cake! I will definitely be using them again! Thank you so much for making this day special for me & my doggie!

AMAZING!!! I called them this morning because I forgot it was my babies birthday (I know bad mom), and they were able to get me a cake made by the afternoon. When I say my seven pups inhaled it…I mean, one shoved a whole piece in his mouth and tried to steal his sisters! I will definitely be ordering from them again. Well worth the price, over and over again! Thank you for making my babies day special!!
Highly recommend! Our Puppy loved his birthday cake, it was so beautiful and I am sure it was delicious too as our puppy loved it and kept asking for more!

They were so easy to work with! Very responsive through text. My babies loved their cake! It was packed super cute and they even gave me two extra cupcakes. Most importantly, I was scared my pups would get upset stomachs because they’re on a raw diet, but they didn’t!
Would definitely recommend!
The cake turned out soo cute and my dog loved it!
Such great work and awesome prices.
So happy with the birthday cake!!
Amazing peanut butter treats

Pawlicious was so great to work with! She went above and beyond to make sure our cake was perfect. She was so flexible on timing and made sure to get us our cake before we went out of town. Can't recommend this business more highly!

Easy to order on her website and very flexible with pick up times!
Beautiful doggy cake and my dogs devoured it easily!

Excellent choice for ordering cake for our dog♥️☺️
Fact: accepted our last minute order on the same day delivery and presentation on the cake was so amazing!
Our dog loved his cake and enjoyed every bite of it.
As promised they used all of cake ingredients fresh!

We got a birthday cake for our dog, Apollo, from Pawlicious Cookies, and it was an amazing experience! The owner was incredibly kind and accommodating, even including a cute birthday hat and decorative candles with the cake. We chose the Carrot Peanut Butter cake, and Apollo absolutely loved it—he could hardly wait to dig in! The quality and presentation were perfect, making his special day even more memorable. Highly recommend Pawlicious Cookies for anyone looking to treat their pup to something special!

My baby turned 7 and he absolutely loved his cake. It was adorable and even came with a cute little hat! They were super easy to work with and took care of me last minute. I will definitely be ordering again soon! Thanks again!
Bailey and Cooper loved the cake
Thank you!
Thank you Pawlicious!  Love your work!!
I wanted to celebrate my fur baby but he does not like dog treats at all! but he loved this cake. Such a cute memory to have with this cake. Thank you!!
10/10! I’ve never seen pups finish a cake more quickly than this delicious treat! I’m beyond impressed and satisfied!
The best company with sweetest owner! The cookies flew off the shelves! Dogs and pet parents loved them! Yolanda customized cookies for us and they were a huge hit! A MUST buy for your furry friend!!
